name: Afghanistan
shortOverview: Afghanistan is a landlocked crossroads country in Central and South Asia. It has a mountainous terrain and a complex history of strategic geopolitical conflict.
capitalLocation: East-central region, along the Kabul River
climate: Arid to semiarid; cold winters and hot summers

name: Albania
shortOverview: Albania is located in southeastern Europe on the Balkan Peninsula. It features beautiful Adriatic and Ionian coastlines and is transitioning to a modern market economy.
capitalLocation: Central Albania, in a valley surrounded by mountains
climate: Mild temperate; cool, wet winters; hot, dry summers

name: Algeria
shortOverview: Algeria is the largest country in Africa, primarily covered by the Sahara Desert. It is a major exporter of natural gas and petroleum products.
capitalLocation: Northern coast along the Mediterranean Sea
climate: Mediterranean on coast; transitional to desert in interior

name: Andorra
shortOverview: Andorra is a tiny, landlocked sovereign principality located in the Pyrenees mountains between France and Spain. It is known for tourism and its tax-haven status.
capitalLocation: High Pyrenees valley in southwestern Andorra
climate: Temperate/alpine; cold, snowy winters and warm, dry summers
headOfState: Co-Princes (Bishop of Urgell and President of France)

name: Angola
shortOverview: Angola is a southern African country with vast mineral and petroleum reserves. It has recovered rapidly from a decades-long civil war to become a regional economic player.
capitalLocation: Atlantic coast in northwestern Angola
climate: Semiarid in south and along coast; tropical north

name: Antigua and Barbuda
shortOverview: Antigua and Barbuda is a twin-island nation in the Americas, lying between the Caribbean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean. It is highly celebrated for its luxury tourism resorts and 365 beaches.
capitalLocation: Northwest coast of Antigua island
climate: Tropical maritime; moderated by trade winds

name: Argentina
shortOverview: Argentina covers most of the southern portion of South America. It is a land of dramatic geography, featuring the rugged Andes, vast grasslands (Pampas), and tango dance heritage.
capitalLocation: Eastern coast, on the Rio de la Plata
climate: Mostly temperate; arid in southeast; subantarctic in southwest.

name: Armenia
shortOverview: Armenia is a landlocked mountainous country in the Caucasus. It has a rich ancient Christian heritage and maintains a complex geopolitical position.
capitalLocation: West-central Armenia along the Hrazdan River
climate: Highland continental; hot summers and cold winters

name: Australia
shortOverview: Australia is the largest country in Oceania and the world's sixth-largest country by total area. It is entirely surrounded by the Indian and Pacific oceans, hosting unique wildlife.
capitalLocation: Inland between Sydney and Melbourne
climate: Mostly arid to semiarid; temperate in south and east; tropical in north.

name: Austria
shortOverview: Austria is a landlocked Central European country dominated by the Alps. It is highly developed, with a rich musical, architectural, and intellectual history centering in Vienna.
capitalLocation: Northeast Austria on the Danube River
climate: Temperate; continental, cloudy winters and cool summers

name: Azerbaijan
shortOverview: Azerbaijan is positioned at the boundary of Eastern Europe and Western Asia. It has rich oil fields in the Caspian Sea and a unique mixed culture of European and Islamic roots.
capitalLocation: Eastern coast on the Absheron Peninsula
climate: Dry, semi-arid steppe; temperate on coast

name: Bahamas
shortOverview: The Bahamas consists of more than 700 islands and cays in the Atlantic Ocean. It is a world-renowned destination for cruise travel, offshore banking, and diving.
capitalLocation: New Providence island
climate: Tropical marine; moderated by the Gulf Stream

name: Bahrain
shortOverview: Bahrain is an island nation in the Persian Gulf composed of a small archipelago. Known for its early pearling and oil-refining economy, it is now an Arab financial capital.
capitalLocation: Northeast corner of Bahrain Island
climate: Arid; extremely hot, humid summers; mild, pleasant winters

name: Bangladesh
shortOverview: Bangladesh is located in the fertile Bengal Delta. It is highly populated, major textile exporter, and highly vulnerable to monsoon flooding and tropical cyclones.
capitalLocation: Geographic center of Bangladesh
climate: Tropical monsoon; warm, wet summers; mild, dry winters

name: Barbados
shortOverview: Barbados is an eastern Caribbean island nation. It combines British colonial heritage with tropical tourism, having recently transitioned from a monarchy to a republic.
capitalLocation: Southwest coast along Carlisle Bay
climate: Tropical maritime; wet season from June to November

name: Belarus
shortOverview: Belarus is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe. It maintains highly centralized state-run economies and strong close political/military ties to neighboring Russia.
capitalLocation: Central Belarus along the Svislach River
climate: Cold winters, cool and wet summers; transitional maritime to continental

name: Belgium
shortOverview: Belgium is a western European country hosting the headquarters of NATO and the European Union. Its historic cities and linguistic division outline its rich cultural tapestry.
capitalLocation: Central Belgium
climate: Temperate maritime; mild, humid, and rainy weather

name: Belize
shortOverview: Belize is a diverse Central American nation with Caribbean coastlines, rich Mayan ruins, and dense inland jungles. It is the only English-speaking nation in Central America.
capitalLocation: Inland, built to escape coastal hurricanes
climate: Subtropical; hot and humid; wet season from May to November

name: Benin
shortOverview: Benin is a key West African state. Historically the site of the Kingdom of Dahomey, it is regarded as the birthplace of Vodun (Voodoo) and has built a stable democratic system.
capitalLocation: Southeast coast, though Cotonou is the de facto economic capital
climate: Tropical; hot, humid in south; semiarid north

name: Bhutan
shortOverview: Bhutan is a remote Himalayan kingdom. Known for its measurement of Gross National Happiness over GDP, it highly cherishes Buddhist traditions and dense, untouched forests.
capitalLocation: West-central highlands valley
climate: Varies from subtropical in south to extreme alpine conditions in northern peaks

name: Bolivia
shortOverview: Bolivia is a landlocked South American country characterized by rugged Andean Altiplano and vast Amazonian lowlands. Features high indigenous representation and lithium resources.
capitalLocation: Sucre (constitutional), La Paz (seat of government)
climate: Humid tropical in lowlands to cold alpine in the Andes

name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
shortOverview: Bosnia and Herzegovina is located in the western Balkans. It has a complex federal political system established under the Dayton Agreement after the 1990s civil conflicts.
capitalLocation: Central mountainous region
climate: Hot summers and cold winters; alpine in high elevations

name: Botswana
shortOverview: Botswana is a landlocked country in Southern Africa. Celebrated for its stable long-term democracy, it hosts the Okavango Delta and is a major global source of diamonds.
capitalLocation: Southeast corner near the South African border
climate: Semiarid subtropical; warm winters and hot summers

name: Brazil
shortOverview: Brazil is the largest country in both South America and Latin America. It encompasses the vast Amazon Basin, home to the world's largest rain forest, and holds a vibrant, football-crazy culture.
capitalLocation: Central-west highlands region
climate: Mostly tropical, but temperate in south.

name: Brunei
officialName: Nation of Brunei, the Abode of Peace
shortOverview: Brunei is a tiny, oil-rich enclave on the island of Borneo. It is governed as an absolute monarchy and maintains high standards of living and welfare for citizens.
capitalLocation: Northern Brunei, near the South China Sea coast
climate: Tropical; hot, humid, and rainy

name: Bulgaria
shortOverview: Bulgaria is located in southeastern Europe, facing the Black Sea. It combines Balkan mountain landscapes with a rich cultural history spanning Greek, Roman, and Slavic eras.
capitalLocation: Western Bulgaria in an alpine valley basin
climate: Temperate; cold, damp winters and warm, dry summers

name: Burkina Faso
shortOverview: Burkina Faso is a landlocked Sahelian nation with a rich cultural arts tradition. It currently faces severe political instability and challenges with regional conflict.
capitalLocation: Center of Burkina Faso
climate: Savanna-arid tropical; three distinct seasons

name: Burundi
shortOverview: Burundi is a small, mountainous landlocked country in East Africa's Great Rift Valley. It is highly agricultural and works to build stable domestic prosperity.
capitalLocation: Gitega (political capital), Bujumbura (economic capital)
climate: Equatorial; highland mild; dry season from June to August

name: Cambodia
shortOverview: Cambodia is located in mainland Southeast Asia. It is home to Angkor Wat, the world's largest religious monument, and represents a recovering post-conflict economy.
capitalLocation: South-central Cambodia at the confluence of the Mekong River
climate: Tropical monsoon; dry season from November to April

name: Cameroon
shortOverview: Cameroon, often termed 'Africa in miniature,' features highly diverse geographic, linguistic, and ecological terrains. It produces major cocoa, timber, and oil resources.
capitalLocation: South-central plateau region
climate: Tropical along coast; semi-arid and hot north

name: Canada
shortOverview: Canada is the world's second-largest country by total area, extending from the Atlantic to the Pacific and northward into the Arctic Ocean. It is renowned for its high standard of living and diverse natural landscapes.
capitalLocation: Southeastern Ontario, near Montreal
climate: Varies from temperate on south coast to subarctic and arctic in the north.

name: Cape Verde
shortOverview: Cabo Verde is an archipelago nation off the west coast of Africa. Renowned for its stable democracy, high metrics of human development, and Morna music.
capitalLocation: Santiago island southwest tip
climate: Temperate dry; low rainfall with maritime moderations

name: Central African Republic
shortOverview: The Central African Republic is a landlocked, resource-rich central African nation. Strategic efforts continue to foster domestic peace and combat persistent insurgencies.
capitalLocation: Southwestern border along the Ubangui River
climate: Tropical; wet summers and dry, dusty winters

name: Chad
shortOverview: Chad is a landlocked country spanning the Sahara, Sahel, and savanna zones. It holds significant strategic military weight in regional anti-terrorism operations.
capitalLocation: Western border at the meeting of Chari and Logone rivers
climate: Arid desert north; semi-arid Sahel; tropical south

name: Chile
shortOverview: Chile is a long, narrow country squeezed between the Andes and the Pacific Ocean. It owns spectacular landscapes and is one of South America's most prosperous economies.
capitalLocation: Central valley basin region
climate: Desert in north (Atacama); mediterranean in center; cool and damp in south

name: China
shortOverview: China is one of the world's oldest continuous civilizations, now serving as a global economic titan and manufacturing nucleus under a single-party socialist system.
capitalLocation: Northeastern China, near Bohai Gulf
climate: Extremely diverse; tropical in south to subarctic in north.

name: Colombia
shortOverview: Colombia is highly biodiverse, spanning Pacific and Caribbean coasts and Andine peaks. It is a major exporter of gourmet coffee and emeralds.
capitalLocation: High plateau in the Andes mountains
climate: Tropical on coasts and eastern plains; cooler with altitude in the Andes

name: Comoros
shortOverview: Comoros is a volcanic archipelago in the Indian Ocean. It represents a mixture of Arab, African, and French cultures, with an economy rooted in spices like vanilla.
capitalLocation: Western coast of Grande Comore island
climate: Tropical maritime with rainy season from November to April

name: Congo (Brazzaville)
shortOverview: Congo-Brazzaville is a West-Central African state with substantial petroleum deposits. It is heavily forested, containing rich biodiversity along the Congo basin.
capitalLocation: Stanley Pool along the Congo River, opposite Kinshasa
climate: Tropical wet; constant heat and humidity

name: Congo (Kinshasa)
shortOverview: DR Congo is the second largest country in Africa, holding critical global reserves of cobalt, copper, and coltan indispensable for modern consumer electronics.
capitalLocation: West-central region along the Congo River
climate: Equatorial; hot and humid; dry season south of equator

name: Costa Rica
shortOverview: Costa Rica is a stable nation in Central America, having abolished its military in 1948. It is a pioneer of ecotourism and green environmental sustainability.
capitalLocation: Central Valley region
climate: Tropical and subtropical; rainy season between May and November

name: Croatia
shortOverview: Croatia is situated on the Adriatic Sea. Its stunning coastal scenery, comprising over 1,000 islands, makes it a prime European tourist hub.
capitalLocation: Continental north along the Sava River
climate: Mediterranean on coast; continental inland

name: Cuba
shortOverview: Cuba is the largest island in the Caribbean. A socialist state characterized by colonial Architecture, rolling tobacco farms, and excellent primary healthcare indices.
capitalLocation: Northwest coast, facing the Florida Straits
climate: Tropical; moderated by trade winds; dry season November to April

name: Cyprus
shortOverview: Cyprus is an island nation in the eastern Mediterranean Sea. De facto split between the Greek Cypriot south and Turkish Cypriot north, it is highly reliant on tourism.
capitalLocation: Mesaoria plain region in the island interior
climate: Subtropical Mediterranean; hot, dry summers and mild winters

name: Czech Republic
shortOverview: Czechia is a landlocked Central European state with a strong industrial center, renowned beer brewing heritage, and a spectacular capital city intact despite WWII.
capitalLocation: Central Bohemia on the Vltava River
climate: Temperate continental; cool summers and cold winters

name: Denmark
shortOverview: Denmark is a Nordic state comprising the Jutland peninsula and numerous islands. It is a high-income welfare nation frequently ranking among the happiest countries globally.
capitalLocation: East coast of Zealand island
climate: Temperate maritime; mild, windy, and wet

name: Djibouti
shortOverview: Djibouti is strategically positioned at the horn of Africa near the Bab-el-Mandeb strait. It hosts multiple foreign military bases, serving as a maritime defense hub.
capitalLocation: Coastal peninsula in Gulf of Tadjoura
climate: Desert; extremely hot, arid conditions year-round

name: Dominica
shortOverview: Known as the 'Nature Isle of the Caribbean' due to its lush, mountainous geothermal landscapes and thermal hot springs like Boiling Lake.
capitalLocation: Southwest coast of the island
climate: Tropical maritime; heavily affected by hurricane risk

name: Dominican Republic
shortOverview: The Dominican Republic shares the island of Hispaniola with Haiti. It is one of the most popular Caribbean travel destinations, featuring major white-sand beach resorts.
capitalLocation: Southern coast
climate: Tropical maritime; little season variation except for rainfall

name: Ecuador
shortOverview: Ecuador spans the equator and includes the iconic Galapagos Islands. It represents a highly biodiverse agrarian economy exporting bananas and crude oil.
capitalLocation: High Andean basin
climate: Tropical in the lowlands; temperate to cold in the Andean highlands

name: Egypt
shortOverview: Egypt is a transcontinental country spanning the northeast corner of Africa and southwest corner of Asia. Home of the ancient pharaohs, its historical monuments like Giza and Luxor are globally famous.
capitalLocation: Northeastern Egypt on the Nile delta
climate: Desert; hot, dry summers; warm, mild winters.

name: El Salvador
shortOverview: El Salvador is the smallest and most densely populated nation in Central America. It made history in 2021 by adopting Bitcoin as legal tender alongside the USD.
capitalLocation: Central valley valley, close to San Salvador Volcano
climate: Tropical; wet season from May to October; dry from November to April

name: Equatorial Guinea
shortOverview: Equatorial Guinea is one of Africa's primary oil exporters. It consists of a mainland territory and several volcanic islands including Bioko.
capitalLocation: Bioko island, though a new capital (Ciudad de la Paz) is under design
climate: Tropical; hot, humid, and cloudy

name: Eritrea
shortOverview: Eritrea is located on the Red Sea. Governed by a highly centralized regime since independence from Ethiopia in 1993, it maintains unique industrial independence policies.
capitalLocation: Central highland plateau
climate: Hot, dry desert along coast; cooler highland interior

name: Estonia
shortOverview: Estonia is a Baltic state known globally as a pioneer in digital government, e-Residency, and high-tech startups.
capitalLocation: North coast facing the Gulf of Finland
climate: Maritime temperate to continental; cold winters and cool summers

name: Eswatini
shortOverview: Eswatini (formerly Swaziland) is a landlocked absolute monarchy in Southern Africa. It preserves deep-rooted cultural festivities like the Umhlanga reed dance.
capitalLocation: Mbabane (administrative), Lobamba (royal and legislative)
climate: Subtropical to temperate with precipitation focused in summer

name: Ethiopia
shortOverview: Ethiopia is Africa's oldest independent country, having resisted European colonization. It holds rich coffee crop histories and houses the African Union Headquarters.
capitalLocation: Central highlands area
climate: Highland temperate; tropical in lowlands

name: Fiji
shortOverview: Fiji is a Melanesian archipelago of more than 300 islands. It represents a highly active regional Pacific economy centering on sugar production and coastal resort travel.
capitalLocation: Southeast coast of Viti Levu island
climate: Tropical maritime with trade winds; little seasonal temperature change

name: Finland
shortOverview: Finland is a highly advanced Nordic nation with dense boreal forests and numerous lakes, frequently topping global indices in education quality and happy citizens.
capitalLocation: Southern coast facing Gulf of Finland
climate: Cold temperate/subarctic; moderated by warm Gulf stream airflows

name: France
shortOverview: France is a historical global center of art, science, and philosophy. It is the most visited country in the world, holding major diplomatic status as a permanent member of the UN Security Council.
capitalLocation: North-central France on the Seine River
climate: Generally cool winters and mild summers; Mediterranean in south.

name: Gabon
shortOverview: Gabon is a coastal Central African state. Extensive equatorial forest cover combined with foreign oil investments make it relatively affluent on a per capita basis.
capitalLocation: Northwest coast near the Gabon Estuary
climate: Tropical wet; trade winds ensure continuous high humidity and rain

name: Gambia
shortOverview: The Gambia is the smallest continental country in Africa, surrounded almost entirely by Senegal except for its Atlantic shore. Heavily centered on peanut agriculture.
capitalLocation: St. Mary's Island at the mouth of the Gambia River
climate: Tropical dry; rainy season from June to October

name: Georgia
shortOverview: Georgia lies in the Caucasus region at the intersection of Eastern Europe and Western Asia. Noted as one of the world's ancient cradle zones of viticulture (winemaking).
capitalLocation: East-Georgia on both banks of the Kura River
climate: Subtropical on Black Sea coast; moderate continental east

name: Germany
shortOverview: Germany is the most populous member state of the European Union and its central economic powerhouse. It has a rich cultural history and is heavily industrialized.
capitalLocation: Northeastern Germany along the Spree river
climate: Temperate and marine; cool, cloudy, wet winters and summers.

name: Ghana
shortOverview: Ghana is a progressive West African state. As the first sub-Saharan state to declare independence from Britain, it is celebrated for stable elections, cocoa, and gold.
capitalLocation: Southeastern coast along the Gulf of Guinea
climate: Tropical; warm and relatively dry south; hotter, arid north

name: Greece
shortOverview: Greece is widely historicized as the cradle of Western civilization, philosophy, democracy, and science. Features a rugged mainland and thousands of beautiful island ports.
capitalLocation: Attica peninsula in southeastern Greece
climate: Mediterranean; mild, wet winters and hot, dry summers

name: Grenada
shortOverview: Known as the 'Island of Spice' due to its massive production of nutmeg and mace crops. This Caribbean nation represents a colorful island landscape.
capitalLocation: Southwest coast of the island
climate: Tropical wet; rainy season from June to December

name: Guatemala
shortOverview: Guatemala has extensive rainforests housing notable ancient Mayan ruins. It holds deep-rooted indigenous customs and volcanic highlands.
capitalLocation: In a mountain valley in south-central Guatemala
climate: Tropical; warmer in coastal plains; temperate to cool in mountainous areas

name: Guinea
shortOverview: Guinea is a West African state holding the world's largest global deposits of bauxite (aluminum ore). Historically famous for the Niger River source highlands.
capitalLocation: Port city on Tombo Island, extending to Kaloum peninsula
climate: Tropical; monsoonal wet season from June to November

name: Guinea-Bissau
shortOverview: Guinea-Bissau consists of low-lying coastal plains and the Bijagos Archipelago. It relies heavily on cashew crop cultivation for agricultural export income.
capitalLocation: Mouth of the Geba River estuary on the Atlantic
climate: Tropical monsoon; warm year-round with dry harmattan winds in winter

name: Guyana
shortOverview: Guyana is a South American nation bordering the Caribbean. It has experienced unprecedented double-digit GDP growth due to major recently unlocked offshore oil reserves.
capitalLocation: East bank of the Demerara River estuary
climate: Tropical; hot, humid with two main wet seasons

name: Haiti
shortOverview: Haiti occupies the western third of Hispaniola. As the first independent nation in Latin America after a historic slave revolt, it works to build modern economic stability.
capitalLocation: Gulf of Gonave coast
climate: Tropical maritime; semi-arid where high mountains block rain

name: Honduras
shortOverview: Honduras has major coffee, banana, and export manufacturing sectors. Features spectacular Mayan remnants like Copan and pristine Caribbean coral reefs.
capitalLocation: South-central mountain valley
climate: Subtropical in highlands; tropical and damp on coasts

name: Hungary
shortOverview: Hungary is a landlocked central European state positioned along the Danube. It boasts ancient thermal spa cultures and highly specialized mathematical/technological traditions.
capitalLocation: Both banks of the Danube River in Central Hungary
climate: Temperate continental; cold winters and warm summers

name: Iceland
shortOverview: Iceland is a Nordic island defined by dramatic volcanic landscapes, active geysers, hot springs, and glaciers. It relies heavily on geothermal energy and marine fisheries.
capitalLocation: Southwest coast along Faxafloi Bay
climate: Subpolar oceanic; relatively mild due to North Atlantic drift

name: India
shortOverview: India is the world's most populous nation and the largest democracy. It is a subcontinent of immense historical depth, cultural diversity, and rapid technological acceleration.
capitalLocation: Northern India, within Delhi metropolis
climate: Varies from tropical monsoon in south to temperate in north.

name: Indonesia
shortOverview: Indonesia is the world's largest archipelago state, consisting of over 17,000 volcanic islands. It is the most populous Muslim-majority state on earth.
capitalLocation: Northwest coast of Java island, though relocating to Nusantara (Kalimantan)
climate: Tropical marine; humid, heavy monsoonal rain patterns

name: Iran
shortOverview: Iran (historically Persia) is a resource-wealthy Middle Eastern energy power. It holds some of the world's earliest urban civilizations and ancient architectural collections.
capitalLocation: Northern lowland slope of Alborz Mountains
climate: Mostly arid to semiarid; subtropical along Caspian sea

name: Iraq
shortOverview: Iraq covers the basin of Mesopotamia, the Tigris-Euphrates cradle of early global civilizations. It operates major, highly strategic OPEC petroleum export facilities.
capitalLocation: Central Iraq along the Tigris River
climate: Mostly hot and arid desert; mild to cool winters; extremely hot, cloudless summers

name: Ireland
shortOverview: Ireland is an island-state known for its lush green terrain, literary masters, and its dynamic tech economy as a primary European base for global tech giants.
capitalLocation: Eastern coast at the mouth of the Liffey River
climate: Temperate maritime; consistently damp with frequent light rainfall

name: Israel
shortOverview: Israel is a historic Middle Eastern state on the Mediterranean. Highly advanced, it has earned the moniker 'Startup Nation' for high-tech innovation and VC investments.
capitalLocation: Judean Mountains, highly contested status
climate: Temperate Mediterranean; hot, dry summers and cool, rainy winters

name: Italy
shortOverview: Italy sits at the heart of the Mediterranean Sea and was the birthplace of the Roman Empire and the Renaissance. It holds the largest number of UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
capitalLocation: Central-western Italian peninsula near Tiber river
climate: Predominantly Mediterranean; alpine in far north; hot, dry in south.

name: Ivory Coast
shortOverview: Ivory Coast is the world's largest producer and exporter of cocoa beans. It operates as an economic locomotive of French-speaking West Africa.
capitalLocation: Inland (Yamoussoukro), although Abidjan is the massive economic port capital
climate: Tropical and humid south; semiarid dry savanna north

name: Jamaica
shortOverview: Jamaica is a Caribbean island nation. Highly recognized for its immense musical influence (reggae) and world-dominating track athletics output.
capitalLocation: Southeast coast, backed by Blue Mountains
climate: Tropical maritime; hot and humid weather with trade wind moderation

name: Japan
shortOverview: Japan is an island nation in East Asia situated in the northwest Pacific Ocean. It is a world leader in technology, automotive manufacturing, and high-speed rail, preserving a strong unique cultural heritage.
capitalLocation: Kanto region of east-central Honshu
climate: Varies from tropical in south to cool temperate in north.

name: Jordan
shortOverview: Jordan is a highly stable Arab kingdom on the East Bank of the Jordan River, renowned for the spectacular ancient rose-red cliff city of Petra.
capitalLocation: Northwest of Jordan on mountainous plateaus
climate: Arid desert; dry and hot; rainy season November to April

name: Kazakhstan
shortOverview: Kazakhstan is the world's largest landlocked country, rich in coal, oil, and uranium resources. It is a dominant economic titan of Central Asia.
capitalLocation: North-central steppes along the Ishim River
climate: Dry, continental steppe; extremely cold winters and hot summers

name: Kenya
shortOverview: Kenya, located on the East African equator, is synonymous with spectacular African wildlife safaris, athletic distance runners, and the vibrant technology hub known as Silicon Savannah.
capitalLocation: South-central highlands
climate: Varies from tropical along coast to arid interior.

name: Kuwait
shortOverview: Kuwait occupies a strategic corner of the northern Persian Persian Gulf, holding an exceptionally strong currency backed by roughly 6% of active global oil stocks.
capitalLocation: Deep water harbor in Kuwait Bay
climate: Arid; extremely hot and dry summers; cooler rainy winters

name: Lebanon
shortOverview: Lebanon lies on the Mediterranean. It features a historic mosaic of diverse religious factions and works to revitalize commercial and financial pathways.
capitalLocation: Coastal peninsula in central Lebanon
climate: Mediterranean; mild, humid winters and hot, dry summers

name: Libya
shortOverview: Libya is a massive, desert-bound North African state holding the continent's largest petroleum reserves. Rebuilding institutions to implement stable national governance.
capitalLocation: Northwest coastal region along the Mediterranean
climate: Mostly desert; dry, windy harmattan airflows

name: Madagascar
shortOverview: Madagascar is the world's fourth largest island, holding uniquely endemic wildlife species (like lemurs) and supplying most of the world's gourmet vanilla bean stocks.
capitalLocation: Central mountainous highlands
climate: Tropical along coasts; temperate inland; arid south

name: Malaysia
shortOverview: Malaysia is split between the Malay Peninsula and Borneo. It is highly developed, exporting electronics, palm oil, and housing Petronas Towers.
capitalLocation: West-central Peninsula, administrative capital at Putrajaya
climate: Equatorial; hot, humid, and rainy year-round

name: Mali
shortOverview: Mali is a landlocked Sahelian state, historically home to the ancient, wealthy Mali Empire and the scholastic libraries of Timbuktu.
capitalLocation: Southwest, along the Niger River
climate: Subtropical to arid; dry harmattan wind season, minimal rain north

name: Mexico
shortOverview: Mexico is located in the southern portion of North America. It is rich in archaeological assets from Mayan and Aztec civilizations, and is a major culinary and cultural capital.
capitalLocation: South-central federal district
climate: Varies from tropical to desert.

name: Morocco
shortOverview: Morocco offers a stunning blend of Arab, Berber, and European influences, backed by the Atlas Mountains and the Sahara Desert. Leads regional tourism and phosphate outputs.
capitalLocation: Northwest near Atlantic coast
climate: Mediterranean on coast; continental and desert interior

name: Netherlands
shortOverview: The Netherlands is a flat European state with about a third of its territory reclaimed from the North Sea using dikes and windmills. Noted for flower crops and social tolerance.
capitalLocation: North-central coastal region, seat of govt at The Hague
climate: Temperate marine; cool summers and mild winters

name: New Zealand
shortOverview: Comprising two main landmasses (the North and South Islands), New Zealand is highly celebrated for its epic mountain ranges, indigenous Maori culture, and pristine agricultural status.
capitalLocation: Southern tip of the North Island
climate: Temperate with sharp regional contrasts; marine.

name: Nigeria
shortOverview: Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa and is a massive cultural hub, leading the continent's cinematic (Nollywood) and musical exports. It has major oil and gas reserves.
capitalLocation: Central-most point of the nation
climate: Varies; equatorial in south, tropical in center, arid in north.

name: Norway
shortOverview: Norway is a mountainous Scandinavian state famous for deep fjords, glaciers, and a colossal sovereign wealth fund built from offshore petroleum exports.
capitalLocation: Southeastern coast at the end of Oslofjord
climate: Temperate maritime along coast; colder and subarctic interior

name: Pakistan
shortOverview: Pakistan has a highly strategic geography stretching from the Arabian Sea to the high Karakoram peaks. Holds a nuclear arsenal and is a central political player in Central-South Asia.
capitalLocation: Northeast on the Potohar Plateau
climate: Arid to semiarid; temperate in northwest; arctic in high north

name: Poland
shortOverview: Poland is a large Central European nation with a highly resilient industrial sector. It has preserved a rich historical heritage despite heavy territorial warfare in WWII.
capitalLocation: East-central Poland on the Vistula River
climate: Temperate transitional; moderately cold winters and mild summers

name: Portugal
shortOverview: Portugal is positioned on the Atlantic shore of the Iberian Peninsula. Its historic maritime discoveries laid global linguistic roots, and it is now a leading renewable energy state.
capitalLocation: West coast along the Tagus River estuary
climate: Mediterranean; warm and temperate maritime variables

name: Russia
shortOverview: Russia is the largest country in the world by land area, stretching across Eastern Europe and Northern Asia. It has a rich heritage of literature, ballet, and chess alongside immense resources.
capitalLocation: Western Russia, on the Moskva River
climate: Ranges from steppes in south through humid continental in much of European Russia; subarctic in Siberia to arctic in polar north.

name: Saudi Arabia
shortOverview: Saudi Arabia occupies the bulk of the Arabian Peninsula. Known as the birthplace of Islam, housing Mecca and Medina, it is a dominant exporter of OPEC petroleum.
capitalLocation: Central desert oasis plateau
climate: Arid desert; extreme temperatures; dry heat

name: South Africa
shortOverview: Known as the 'Rainbow Nation' due to its multiethnic diversity, South Africa is located at the southern tip of Africa. It has a complex history shaped by the legacy of apartheid and subsequent reconciliation led by Nelson Mandela.
capitalLocation: Pretoria (executive), Cape Town (legislative), Bloemfontein (judicial)
climate: Mostly semiarid; subtropical along east coast.

name: South Korea
shortOverview: South Korea is a major technological and industrial superpower in East Asia. It has achieved massive worldwide cultural exports through K-Pop, drama, and digital innovation.
capitalLocation: Northwest region on the Han River
climate: Temperate; cold, dry winters; hot, humid monsoonal summers

name: Spain
shortOverview: Spain is located on the Iberian Peninsula in southwestern Europe. It has a rich global heritage extending from the Age of Discovery and possesses beautiful coastal tourism landscapes.
capitalLocation: Geographic center of the Iberian Peninsula
climate: Temperate; clear, hot summers in interior, more moderate and cloudy along coast.

name: Sweden
shortOverview: Sweden is a Nordic state with an exceptionally high standard of living, known for Nobel Prizes, IKEA, and structural neutrality throughout historic 20th-century conflicts.
capitalLocation: Southeast coast, across an archipelago in Lake Mälaren
climate: Temperate north; milder in south due to warming maritime gulf airflows

name: Switzerland
shortOverview: Switzerland is a central landlocked Alpine state famed for its history of armed political neutrality, secure banking institutions, precision watches, and high-quality chocolates.
capitalLocation: West-central Swiss plateau
climate: Temperate alpine; varies widely with altitude

name: Turkey
shortOverview: Türkiye is a transcontinental bridge state spanning Europe and Asia. Features an incredibly rich historic legacy spanning Ottoman and Byzantine Empires, controlling the Bosporus.
capitalLocation: Central Anatolian plateau region
climate: Mediterranean along coasts; continental and dry interior

name: Ukraine
shortOverview: Ukraine is a massive Eastern European agrarian producer, often hailed as the 'breadbasket of Europe' for its fertile black soil plains. Rebuilding infrastructure and resilience.
capitalLocation: North-central Ukraine on the Dnieper River
climate: Temperate continental; humid; Mediterranean in southern Crimea

name: United Kingdom
officialName: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
shortOverview: The United Kingdom consists of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. It is an island nation with a rich global imperial history and a pioneer of the Industrial Revolution.
capitalLocation: Southeastern England on the River Thames
climate: Temperate; moderated by prevailing southwest winds over the North Atlantic Current.

name: United States
shortOverview: The United States is a federal republic comprising 50 states, a federal district, and five self-governing territories. It is the world's primary economic and military superpower, founded in 1776.
capitalLocation: District of Columbia, eastern US coast
climate: Mostly temperate, but tropical in Hawaii and Florida, arctic in Alaska, semiarid in the great plains.

name: Vietnam
shortOverview: Vietnam is situated on the eastern of Indochina Peninsula. It has evolved to become a highly dynamic Asian industrial factory nucleus, welcoming major global assembly chains.
capitalLocation: Northern Vietnam along the Red River delta
climate: Tropical in south; monsoonal in north with hot, rainy summers
